_original_lore: Livid is the boss of Floor 5 of the Catacombs. He is a
'Master Necromancer' and has only one phase. In this
phase he makes eight clones of himself. Each with
different abilities. The player must kill the
true livid to complete the boss fight.
name: 利维德 (首领)

source: Livid is the boss of Floor {{N0}} of the Catacombs. He is a
'Master Necromancer' and has only one phase. In this
phase he makes eight clones of himself. Each with
different abilities. The player must kill the
true livid to complete the boss fight.
loreParagraphs.translation: 利维德是地牢第 {{N0}} 层的首领.他是一名'死灵大师',只有一个阶段.在这个阶段中,他会制造八个自己的分身,每个分身都有不同的能力.玩家必须杀死真正的利维德才能完成这场首领战.
